name: Search Input
description: A text field with a leading search affordance, clear action, and loading state.

anatomy.description: The decorative search glyph pinned inside the field.
The native text field that owns the query.
A labeled action that appears once the field has a value and resets it.
Replaces the clear button while results load.

dos: Handle onClear and reset the caller-owned value when the clear action fires.
Use the loading state while fetching so typing stays uninterrupted.
Write placeholders as examples, like Name or owner….
donts: Don't use SearchInput for general text entry; use Input.
Don't navigate on every keystroke without debouncing the query.
Don't keep the spinner on after results arrive; it hides the clear action.

examples.title: Clearable search
examples.description: The clear button appears once the field has a value; loading swaps in a spinner.

examples.title: Filled, loading, and disabled
examples.description: The clear action shows on filled fields, swaps for a spinner while loading, and disappears when disabled.

examples.title: Loading results
examples.description: The loading state replaces the clear action while results refresh.

guidance.useWhen: A field exists specifically to query a collection.
guidance.avoidWhen: The input is general-purpose text entry; use Input.
guidance.behavior: The clear action appears only with a value, and loading swaps it for a spinner.
guidance.responsive: Icons stay pinned inside the field at any width.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the field and the clear button when it is visible.
Activates the clear button and resets the value.
Edits the query using native text editing keys.

notes: The leading search icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
The clear action is an IconButton labeled Clear search.
The loading state swaps the clear action for a spinner, keeping focus on the field.
